criteria.title: The full interactive execution report loads

steps.prompt: Wait for the report to finish loading, then click the Toggle theme button in the top right corner of the full report. If a loading placeholder is visible, wait and observe again before clicking.

The full Midscene interactive report is visible: it has an Execution panel with recorded Tap, Boolean and Assert entries and a Record replay area. It is not a loading placeholder or a load failure page.
